{"metadata":{"description":"MCP server management for DeepSeek Harness: author composition rows, choose when an allowed server loads, and filter which of its tools a session may call","id":"gh:1375384585","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-mcp-manager","slug":"zhang-guo-wen/dsh-mcp-manager","topics":["cordis","deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"MCP server management for DeepSeek Harness: author composition rows, choose when an allowed server l"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"oads, and filter which of its tools a session may call"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"description: "Manage MCP servers in DeepSeek Harness, load them on demand, and filter tools to reduc"},{"id":"p2s2","text":"e context usage"
kind: "plugin-readme""},{"id":"p3s1","text":"# @guowenzhang/dsh-mcp-manager"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"中文 | English"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## The problem this plugin solves"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"Adding MCP servers to DeepSeek Harness is inconvenient, and loading every configured server's tools "},{"id":"p6s2","text":"by default consumes substantial context."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"This plugin adds server creation, editing, and per-row switches to the settings page. With on-demand"},{"id":"p7s2","text":" loading, the initial context contains only MCP names and descriptions; the model enables servers as"},{"id":"p7s3","text":" needed during a session. Tool filtering lets you load only the tools you select."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"In the plugin list, display names and descriptions follow the Harness language setting in English or"},{"id":"p8s2","text":" Chinese (English is the default fallback); English names use the package name without its npm scope"},{"id":"p8s3","text":", Chinese names describe the purpose, and installation still uses the unchanged real package name."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Screenshots"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"**MCP management: Servers**"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"**MCP management: Settings**"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"One page with two tabs: **Servers** holds the roster, **Settings** holds the loading mode and how mu"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"ch of a tool list one call hands to the model. The server list scrolls independently while the page "},{"id":"p12s3","text":"heading, tabs, Add button and filters stay in place. Agent preset names use the same Host translatio"},{"id":"p12s4","text":"ns as the new-session picker and update with the interface language; authored names remain unchanged"},{"id":"p12s5","text":". The roster is one list — global rows first, labelled **Global**, then the rows of the agent preset"},{"id":"p12s6","text":" picked in the filter bar. Click the card itself to open the editor: **Config / Credentials / Tools*"},{"id":"p12s7","text":"*; a row that carries an environment or a header opens straight on **Credentials**. Where an added r"},{"id":"p12s8","text":"ow is written is chosen in the dialog's own **Config scope** select, which lists the global plane an"},{"id":"p12s9","text":"d every declared agent preset in one field; the tools pane shows each tool's estimated token cost an"},{"id":"p12s10","text":"d the totals for what is loaded and what a rule would drop. A switch that fails reports in its own r"},{"id":"p12s11","text":" what is loaded and what a rule would drop. A switch that fails reports in its own row with a retry."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"Requires DeepSeek Harness, `pnpm`, and Node.js ≥22.18 or ≥24.2."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"Restart the host and refresh the page, then open **Settings → MCP management** to add servers and de"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"scribe their purpose. The page has two tabs: **Servers** (the roster: one list, global rows first wi"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"th a **Global** label, then the rows of the agent preset the filter bar selects; click a card to ope"},{"id":"p16s4","text":"n its editor, whose **Config / Credentials / Tools** panes hold the JSON, the environment or headers"},{"id":"p16s5","text":", and the tool list) and **Settings** (**MCP loading**, where Dynamic insert is the default, followe"},{"id":"p16s6","text":"d by how much of a tool list reaches the model). The **Config scope** select picks an added row's ho"},{"id":"p16s7","text":"me in one field: the global plane, or one agent preset. In the add form the two fields marked `*` (s"},{"id":"p16s8","text":"erver name, JSON configuration) are required, and the server name is filled from the JSON you paste "},{"id":"p16s9","text":"(`npx -y @upstash/context7-mcp` → `context7`); once you edit it yourself, it is yours."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"See AGENTS.md for other installation methods and development instructions."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## Reduce context further: search, paging, names only"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"**Settings → MCP management → Settings** controls how much of a tool list reaches the model, and car"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"ries the loading mode. The MCP specification has no query parameter on `tools/list` and no names-onl"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"y listing, and the client best-practices guide places progressive discovery in the host — which is w"},{"id":"p19s4","text":"he client best-practices guide places progressive discovery in the host — which is what this tab is:"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"| Setting | Effect |"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"| **Tool search** (`search`) | Registers `mcp_search`: the model finds tools by keyword across every"},{"id":"p21s2","text":" discovered server and gets names plus one-line descriptions only. |
| **Index uncached servers** (`"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"searchIndex`) | Lets a search connect to a server it has no tool list for (3 at a time, 8 seconds ea"},{"id":"p21s4","text":"ch). Off by default, so a search stays a cheap read. |
| **Items per listing** (`pageSize`) | `mcp_l"},{"id":"p21s5","text":"oad` / `mcp_search` list at most this many items and return `nextCursor` for the rest. |
| **Names a"},{"id":"p21s6","text":"nd descriptions only** (`namesOnly`) | `mcp_load` omits argument schemas by default; asking for one "},{"id":"p21s7","text":"tool by name still returns that tool's full schema. |
| **Tools collected per server** (`maxTools`) "},{"id":"p21s8","text":"| Caps the paginated `tools/list` walk, so an enormous server cannot flood a request. |
| **Show too"},{"id":"p21s9","text":"l annotations** (`annotations`) | Carries the server's `readOnlyHint` / `destructiveHint` / `idempot"},{"id":"p21s10","text":"entHint` / `openWorldHint` into listings. |
| **Hide destructive tools** (`hideDestructive`) | Keeps"},{"id":"p21s11","text":" tools whose `destructiveHint` is explicitly true out of the session entirely. |"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"The same page shows what the tool catalogue has cached (servers, tool counts, age) and can clear bot"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"h memory and disk records. Every switch is a live setting: it applies to the next load, search, or r"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"e-index without a restart."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"## Notes"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"- **On-demand loading covers both planes, and nothing starts at host start-up.** Under Dynamic inser"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"t (`dynamic`, default) and Lazy loading (`lazy`) an allowed row is suppressed before its plugin ever"},{"id":"p25s3","text":" runs, so host start-up and Agent preset rebuilds start no MCP process at all; the first `mcp_load` "},{"id":"p25s4","text":"starts the connection. Global composition rows follow the same loading mode: Load all (`eager`) moun"},{"id":"p25s5","text":"ts them from the composition, while `dynamic` / `lazy` keep them held until `mcp_load` starts one on"},{"id":"p25s6","text":" a connection shared with other sessions. Tool filters still do not take effect on a global row.
- *"},{"id":"p25s7","text":"*Load on demand, then reuse.** Connections live in a host-level pool keyed by row and connection con"},{"id":"p25s8","text":"figuration: the same server loaded again — by the same session, another session, or a subagent — reu"},{"id":"p25s9","text":"ses that one connection (for stdio, the same child process). `mcp_unload` releases only the calling "},{"id":"p25s10","text":"session's reference; the server stops when the last session releases it, and a session that ends rel"},{"id":"p25s11","text":"eases its references. The connection lives as long as the host process — committing a different load"},{"id":"p25s12","text":"ing mode rebuilds the tool set and releases that mode's references, and a host restart means loading"},{"id":"p25s13","text":" the server again. "Nothing starts at start-up" holds whether or not the server was loaded before.
